dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you're helping with the university's new campaign. What's it called?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, jʊr ˈhɛlpɪŋ wɪð ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ˈnuː kæmˈpeɪn. ˈwʌts ɪt ˈkɔːld?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What will be done during the campaign?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt wɪl bi ˈdʌn ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə kæmˈpeɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: First, five hundred trees will be planted around the university.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst, ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈtriːz wɪl bi ˈplæntɪd əˈraʊnd ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a lot of trees! And what about plastic?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈtriːz! ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈplæstɪk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Single-use cups and straws will be banned in the cafeteria.
dialogue.reading: ˌsɪŋɡəl ˈjuːs ˈkʌps ənd ˈstrɔːz wɪl bi ˈbænd ɪn ðə ˌkæfəˈtɪriə.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Really? What will students use instead?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwʌt wɪl ˈstuːdənts ˈjuːz ɪnˈstɛd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Eco-friendly cups will be sold at the café, and every new student will be given a free bottle.
dialogue.reading: ˌiːkoʊ ˈfrɛndli ˈkʌps wɪl bi ˈsoʊld ət ðə kæˈfeɪ, ənd ˈɛvri ˈnuː ˈstuːdənt wɪl bi ˈɡɪvən ə ˈfriː ˈbɑːtəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is the government doing anything, too?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ˈduːɪŋ ˈɛniθɪŋ, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. The government wants to ban plastic bags in all stores.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ˈwɑːnts tə ˈbæn ˈplæstɪk ˈbæɡz ɪn ˈɔːl ˈstɔːrz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's great. Good luck with the campaign!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡreɪt. ˈɡʊd ˈlʌk wɪð ðə kæmˈpeɪn!
